facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that NIRA encourages citizens to use the eAqoonsi mobile application for services.

SOM.note: No link between civil register and ID system is mentioned.
Business registration appears only as a service planned for the Halmeel platform due by March 2027.
About two million enrolled is given with no population share, so no share is stated.
Integration with banking, passports and travel is an effort under way, not a public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Somalia launched its biometric national ID system in 2023 and NIRA says about two million people have been enrolled (October 2026).

SOM.note: The people enrolled are citizens returning from Yemen, which the study treats as returnees, not refugees or internally displaced people.
